clauses.name: Gorlok, the Blinded Indiscreet
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Gorlok is in the Interzone, whenever an opponent draws one or more cards outside of the Recovery Phase, that opponent shows the drawn cards to you. Choose and Exile one card among them, then Gorlok gets -1 power for each card the opponent showed to you this way.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Each opponent draw outside Recovery creates its own immutable group of drawn hand instances. Resolve surviving instances only, in Stack order, without consuming another trigger's group. Show those cards, exile exactly one and apply power loss equal to the number shown to the original source still present. Effect survives source departure; exclude immune hands, invalid and repeated answers and private draw identities before resolution.
